name: Bulwark
description: A shield for everything you publish. Every request is checked in microseconds against 250k+ blocklisted addresses and known attack payloads; attackers are banned on every tunnel at once. Its own dashboard shows every request in full, warns about waves of attackers before they peak, graphs the patterns, keeps your blocklist and reports attackers to the vendors that missed them. On by default; no slower tunnels.
author: Alexd Aero

update_card.title: {name} {version}
update_card.tagline: Holds up under a huge attack wave instead of taking the machine down with it.
highlights: The gate no longer piles up memory when the Bulwark app falls behind
Wave tracking stays fast with tens of thousands of attackers (was minutes of CPU)
Logs have a disk budget; a restart reads only the tail of a huge day
Fewer disk writes per ban, capped scan queue, at most 6 alerts out a minute
The service is capped at 640 MB and 80% CPU so the machine stays up

actions.label: Stop
actions.confirm: The dashboard, lookups, waves and reports stop. The guard inside Burrow keeps enforcing bans and blocklists on its own.
